title: Should, must, and so
label: ch:gu-should-must-and-so
canDo: I can say what someone should do and has to do (tamāre javũ joīe, māre javũ paḍśe), and join a reason to its result with eṭle or tethī.

payoff.summary: Complete GU-R278-advice-and-result: give advice, say what has to be done, and say what follows.
